item.title: Deere and Mercedes-Benz Invest in Humanoid Robots
item.description: AUSTIN, TX—John Deere and Mercedes-Benz are among several companies that are investing more than $500 million in Apptronik, a startup that has developed a humanoid robot called Apollo.

item.title: New EV Charger Content Requirements Could Undermine Infrastructure Growth
item.description: WASHINGTON—Implementing a domestic content threshold on EV chargers could undermine the U.S. clean vehicle industry.

item.title: BorgWarner Unveils Plans for Next-Generation Drive Modules
item.description: AUBURN HILLS, MI—BorgWarner has secured a contract with a major North American automaker to provide an 800-volt secondary integrated drive module.

item.title: Mecad USA plans Oklahoma manufacturing site, nearly 300 jobs projected
item.description: TULSA, Okla. — Mecad USA said it will locate its U.S. operations at the Tulsa Port of Catoosa in a move expected to create nearly 300 jobs in northeastern Oklahoma.

item.title: New F1 Rules Push Red Bull, Ford to Rebuild Powertrain with Help from Hexagon
item.description: COBHAM, England — When Formula 1 rewrites its rulebook, it doesn’t just change what happens on the track, it forces a full reset in the factory.

item.title: Dürr Unveils Robot System That Prints Designs Directly on Car Bodies
item.description: SOUTHFIELD, Mich. — Dürr is rolling out a new high-resolution paint application system that lets automakers print complex graphics, patterns and lettering directly onto vehicle bodies, replacing the manual step of gluing on films and decals.

item.title: Siemens Energy to Invest $1B to Expand U.S. Manufacturing, Add 1,500 Jobs
item.description: Siemens Energy plans to invest $1 billion to expand U.S. production of grid and gas turbine equipment and hire more than 1,500 workers as electricity demand surges from data centers, artificial intelligence infrastructure and industrial electrification.

item.title: Manufacturing Gained 5,000 Jobs in January
item.description: WASHINGTON—Manufacturers added 5,000 jobs in January, according to the latest data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).

item.title: Thieves Steal New Cars From Stellantis Assembly Plant
item.description: DETROIT—Thieves stole nearly a dozen new Ram pickup trucks, Jeep SUVs and Dodge Durangos from a temporary storage lot near Stellantis’s Detroit Assembly Complex–Jefferson in the early morning hours of Feb. 11.

item.title: ASSEMBLY Audible: Linir Zamir on how the deviceWISE Intelligence Suite Brings AI to the Edge
item.description: Telit Cinterion’s Dr. Linir Zamir discusses how Artificial Intelligence is moving closer to the factory floor through edge-based systems that keep data on site and enable faster decision-making.
